### Task Handoff: P7T9-A (`ai-title` Provenance and Generation Measurement)

#### 1. What Was Measured
- **Whole On-Disk Corpus**: Scanned all 806 project directories under `~/.claude/projects/`, analyzing 1,220 top-level `.jsonl` session files and 102 nested subagent `.jsonl` files (`<sessionId>/subagents/*.jsonl`).
- **Vault Directory Specifically**: Analyzed all 156 `.jsonl` session files in `~/.claude/projects/-Users-emregultekir-Documents-EmreOS/`.
- **Session Attributes**: Measured total records, line counts, user prompts (distinguishing human prompts from tool results/metadata), assistant records, session duration, cost state presence, session age, resumption indicators, and CLI versions.
- **Position & Timing**: Measured line offsets (min, 25%, median, 75%, max, mean) and timestamp deltas between the first user prompt and `ai-title` neighbor timestamps across both the vault and the full corpus.
- **Markers & Process Types**: Contrasted interactive terminal sessions against headless plugin sessions spawned with `-p --input-format stream-json --output-format stream-json`.
- **Configuration & CLI Binary**: Inspected `~/.claude/settings.json` (and all JSON files under `~/.claude/`) and reverse-engineered the Claude Code binary (`/Users/emregultekir/.local/share/claude/versions/2.1.270`) to trace title generation logic and gating mechanisms.

---

#### 2. The Answers to the Six Questions

- **Question 1 (Corpus-Wide Counts & Ratios)**:
  - **Top-Level Sessions**: Across 806 project directories, there are **1,220 total session files**. **548 (44.92%)** contain at least one `ai-title` record; **672 (55.08%)** do not. Total `ai-title` records across the corpus: **4,279**. `[Measured]`
  - **Subagent Transcripts**: 102 subagent files exist; **0 (0.00%)** contain an `ai-title` record. Subagents never receive `ai-title` records. `[Measured]`
  - **Category Breakdown**:
    - *Named Persistent Repositories (12 dirs)*: 356 sessions, 183 with `ai-title` (**51.40%**), 3,560 records. `[Measured]`
    - *EmreOS Compile Stage Worktrees (29 dirs)*: 29 sessions, 29 with `ai-title` (**100.00%**), 82 records. `[Measured]`
    - *DraftCV Worktrees (3 dirs)*: 8 sessions, 6 with `ai-title` (**75.00%**), 90 records. `[Measured]`
    - *Ephemeral `/tmp` Scratchpads (38 dirs)*: 94 sessions, 36 with `ai-title` (**38.30%**), 90 records. `[Measured]`
    - *Ephemeral `/var` Benchmarks (724 dirs)*: 733 sessions, 294 with `ai-title` (**40.11%**), 457 records. `[Measured]`

- **Question 2 (Vault Directory & Distinguishing Attributes)**:
  - Total vault sessions: **156**. **91 (58.33%)** have an `ai-title`; **65 (41.67%)** do not. `[Measured]`
  - Sessions with `ai-title` exhibit significantly higher engagement and duration:
    - *Human turns*: Median **13.0** turns (mean 17.6) vs **2.0** turns (mean 5.3) without. `[Measured]`
    - *Total lines*: Median **424.0** lines (mean 471.7) vs **30.0** lines (mean 89.4) without. `[Measured]`
    - *Session duration*: Median **3,520.6s (58.7m)** vs **68.0s (1.1m)** without. `[Measured]`
    - *Cost-state presence*: **64 / 91 (70.3%)** vs **2 / 65 (3.1%)** without. `[Measured]`
    - *Session age*: Comparable span (median 11.5 days vs 11.3 days). `[Measured]`
  - **Decisive Root Cause in Vault**: Entrypoint and CLI version.
    - Terminal sessions (`entrypoint: "cli"`): **72 / 74 (97.30%)** have `ai-title`. `[Measured]`
    - Plugin sessions (`entrypoint: "sdk-cli"`): **17 / 80 (21.25%)** have `ai-title`. `[Measured]`
    - Every un-titled plugin session with >0 turns was run on an older CLI version (< 2.1.268, prior to 2026-09-10). On modern CLI versions (`2.1.268`–`2.1.270`), **17 of 18 (94.4%)** plugin sessions in the vault DO have an `ai-title`. The only missing one was aborted before Turn 1 completed (0 assistant responses). `[Measured]`

- **Question 3 (Record Position & Timestamp Gap)**:
  - Across the whole corpus, the first `ai-title` record sits at: Min line 1, 25% line 7, **Median line 13**, 75% line 18, Max line 1,140 (Mean line 16.4). Relative position median: **0.524** (52.4% into the file for short sessions; **0.046** / 4.6% into the file for long multi-turn sessions). `[Measured]`
  - In the vault, first `ai-title` sits at: Min line 1, 25% line 20, **Median line 22**, 75% line 28, Max line 77 (Mean line 23.9). `[Measured]`
  - **Timestamp Gap**: The time delta between the first user record timestamp and the subsequent record after `ai-title` has a median of **6.69 seconds** in the vault (**10.19 seconds** corpus-wide). `[Measured]`
  - **Multi-Record Persistence**: 309 files contain multiple `ai-title` records (up to 227 per file). In 100% of these files, the title text is identical across all records; `ai-title` is re-appended alongside state snapshots during later turns or session serialization. `[Measured]`

- **Question 4 (Late Arrival & Listing Race Conditions)**:
  - **Yes, `ai-title` appears late**. `[Measured]`
  - Because the CLI issues an asynchronous background model call (`this._engine.generateSessionTitle`) while streaming the assistant's turn, `ai-title` lands ~5 to 15 seconds after the first user record is written to disk.
  - A directory scan (`scanSessionsDir`) performed during this initial window observes `title === undefined` and derives a fallback title from the prompt text (`derivedTitle`). A scan performed after the background call completes reads the authentic `ai-title`.
  - Furthermore, in 37 corpus sessions, the first `ai-title` record did not appear until Turn 2–6 (and in one session, not until line 1,140 upon session resumption). `[Measured]`

- **Question 5 (Plugin Sessions vs Terminal Sessions)**:
  - **Measurable Markers**:
    - `entrypoint`: `"sdk-cli"` for plugin sessions vs `"cli"` for terminal sessions. `[Measured]`
    - `promptSource`: `"sdk"` for plugin sessions vs `"typed"` for terminal sessions. `[Measured]`
  - **Differences**:
    - Interactive terminal sessions have generated `ai-title` across all CLI versions (97.3% in vault).
    - Plugin sessions did not generate `ai-title` in versions prior to `2.1.268` (0/62 in vault), but generate them consistently in versions $\ge 2.1.268$ (17/18 in vault).
    - In 12 of the 17 modern plugin sessions, `ai-title` is prepended to **line 1** upon session restoration/resume in addition to turn offsets. `[Measured]`

- **Question 6 (Configuration & Environment Gating)**:
  - **Settings**: Inspection of `~/.claude/settings.json` and all configuration files in `~/.claude/` revealed **zero settings** relating to session titles. `[Measured]`
  - **Environment Gating**: The CLI binary recognizes `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_TERMINAL_TITLE`. When set, the title manager sets `disabled: true`, short-circuiting title generation in `_runImpl`. (Plugin code explicitly strips `CLAUDE*` variables in `claude-process.ts`, so this flag is not set during plugin runs). `[Measured]`
  - **Runtime Gating**: The binary enforces internal conditions before triggering generation: `!disabled`, no existing manual `sessionTitle`, no existing `aiSessionTitle`, not a subagent (`!agentTitle`), prompt is not a slash command, prompt text is non-empty, and valid network credentials exist. `[Measured]`
